name: manual_f2ab09
claim: A policy helper never grants an operator exception: it refuses, and the trusted dispatcher enforces the exception by spending one domain-separated P5 receipt rebuilt from its own launch fields.

decisions.notes: Metadata proofs cannot prove an operator decision; rebuilding the intent from dispatcher-owned fields lets the signed digest bind model, effort, fast flag, scope, expiry and request identity, and a mismatch refuses before the receipt is spent.

rationale: Metadata proofs cannot prove an operator decision; rebuilding the intent from dispatcher-owned fields lets the signed digest bind model, effort, fast flag, scope, expiry and request identity, and a mismatch refuses before the receipt is spent.
